steps: Go to the official Chase offer page https://account.chase.com/consumer/banking/seo and enroll — this registers your coupon for the $400 bonus (applying from the regular Chase homepage will not qualify).
Complete the online application for a Chase Total Checking account and get approved; save the confirmation email with your coupon code.
Note your coupon enrollment date — your direct-deposit qualification window runs from that date.
In the Chase Mobile app or at chase.com, find your new account and routing numbers.

Ask your employer's payroll (or pension/government benefits provider) to direct-deposit your paycheck there until deposits total $1,000+ within 90 days of coupon enrollment — Zelle, Venmo, and bank-to-bank transfers do not count.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $400 bonus is deposited within 15 days after you complete the requirements.
To avoid the $15 monthly fee, keep $500+ in qualifying electronic deposits per statement period (your bonus-run deposits cover this) or meet another fee waiver.
timing: Bonus deposited within 15 days after completing all requirements listed on your offer.
